people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

people.name: Mary_Magdalene
people.line: Follower of Jesus, first witness of His resurrection.

translations.web: Jesus said to her, “Mary.” She turned and said to him, “Rabboni!” which is to say, “Teacher!”
translations.bsb: Jesus said to her, “Mary.” She turned and said to Him in Hebrew, “Rabboni!” (which means “Teacher”).
translations.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Mary. She turned herself, and saith unto him, Rabboni; which is to say, Master.
translations.asv: Jesus saith unto her, Mary. She turneth herself, and saith unto him in Hebrew, Rabboni; which is to say, Teacher.
